sizable.definition:
s fairly large
s large in amount or extent or degree
sizable.translation: a. 相当大的, 大小相当的

sizar.definition:
n. One of a body of students in the universities of Cambridge
   (Eng.) and Dublin, who, having passed a certain examination, are
   exempted from paying college fees and charges. A sizar corresponded to
   a servitor at Oxford.

sizarship.definition: n. The position or standing of a sizar.

size.definition:
n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
n. the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing)
n. any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics
n. the actual state of affairs
size.translation:
n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
vi. 可比拟
a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的

size of memory.translation: [计] 存储器空量, 存储器大小

size of product.translation: [化] 产品规格; 产品尺寸规格

sizeable.definition:
s fairly large
s large in amount or extent or degree
sizeable.translation: a. 相当大的, 可观的

sized.definition:
a. having a specified size
a. having the surface treated or coated with sizing
sized.translation: a. 依大小排列的, 依大小调整的, 型号的, ...尺码的

sizer.translation:
n. 筛分器
[化] 填料器; 上胶器

sizes.definition:
n the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
n the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing)
n any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics
n the actual state of affairs
n a large magnitude
v cover or stiffen or glaze a porous material with size or sizing (a glutinous substance)
v sort according to size
v make to a size; bring to a suitable size
sizes.translation: n. 象素显示尺寸, 尺寸（size复数形式）

siziness.definition: n. The quality or state of being sizy; viscousness.

sizing.definition:
n any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics
v cover or stiffen or glaze a porous material with size or sizing (a glutinous substance)
v sort according to size
v make to a size; bring to a suitable size
sizing.translation:
n. 涂料, 上浆
[计] 调整大小

sizing agent.translation: [化] 胶粘剂; 浆料(纺); 施胶剂; 上浆剂

sizy.definition: a. Sizelike; viscous; glutinous; as, sizy blood.
sizy.translation: a. 浆料(似)的, 黏稠的

sizz.definition:
v express or utter with a hiss
v make a sharp hissing sound, as if to show disapproval
sizz.translation:
vi. 发咝咝声
n. 咝咝声

sizzle.definition:
n. a sizzling noise
v. make a sound like frying fat
v. seethe with deep anger or resentment
v. burn or sear with a sizzling sound
sizzle.translation:
vi. 发出嘶嘶声
vt. 烧灼
n. 咝咝声

sizzled.translation: v. 发咝咝声( sizzle的过去式和过去分词 ); 表现良好, 进行顺利; 把…烧得哧哧响, 烧焦; 恶言相骂

sizzler.translation: n. 极烫的东西, 炎热天

sizzlers.translation: (sizzler 的复数) n. 极烫的东西, 炎热天

sizzles.definition:
n a sizzling noise
v make a sound like frying fat
v seethe with deep anger or resentment
v burn or sear with a sizzling sound
sizzles.translation: v. 发咝咝声( sizzle的第三人称单数 ); 表现良好, 进行顺利; 把…烧得哧哧响, 烧焦; 恶言相骂

sizzling.definition: s. hot enough to burn with or as if with a hissing sound
sizzling.translation: v. 发咝咝声( sizzle的现在分词 ); 表现良好, 进行顺利; 把…烧得哧哧响, 烧焦; 恶言相骂
